summary: Challenge your mind with minimalist logic puzzle game with automation.
description:
Dive into the world of the Sequence, a captivating puzzle game that challenges your logical thinking and problem-solving skills. This game is perfect for those who love strategic thinking and complex puzzles, providing hours of brain-teasing fun. Test your mind with complex sequences and automation challenges that will keep you engaged for hours!

Game Overview:
In the Sequence, your objective is to create a working sequence using various modules. Each level presents a unique puzzle that requires careful planning and strategic placement of components to achieve automation. The minimalist design and intuitive gameplay make it accessible for new players while offering depth and complexity for puzzle enthusiasts.

Key Features:
Logic Puzzles: Dive into a variety of logic-based challenges that test your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
Automation Game: Design and build automated sequences to solve intricate puzzles. Think like a programmer and create efficient solutions!
Programming Puzzles: Each level requires careful planning and execution, mimicking the logic of programming and automation.
Brain Teaser: Exercise your brain with progressively challenging levels that push your cognitive abilities to the limit.
Minimalist Puzzle: Enjoy a sleek, minimalist design that focuses on pure puzzle gameplay without distractions.
Sequence Building: Strategically place modules to build sequences that achieve the desired outcome. Each module has unique properties that interact in complex ways.
Strategic Thinking: Plan your moves carefully to create the most efficient and effective sequences. Every move counts!
Challenging Puzzles: From simple to highly complex, each puzzle presents a new challenge that will keep you hooked.

Why You'll Love the Sequence:
Innovative Gameplay: Unlike traditional puzzle games, the Sequence integrates elements of automation and programming, offering a fresh and intellectually stimulating experience.
Educational Value: Perfect for those interested in programming and logical thinking. Learn and improve your problem-solving skills in a fun and engaging way.
Beautifully Designed: The minimalist aesthetic ensures that the focus remains on the puzzles, providing a clean and enjoyable visual experience.
Endless Challenges: With a variety of levels ranging in difficulty, there’s always a new challenge to tackle.
Intuitive Controls: Easy-to-use controls make it simple to place and modify modules, allowing you to focus on solving the puzzle.

"The best part of Sequence is that the design is spot-on for puzzle fanatics and casual fans alike." - TouchArcade
"Finding the right sequence is harder than it looks." - AppAdvice
"The Sequence is a unique spin on the mobile puzzler." - Gamezebo

the Sequence features:

- Variety of different levels to beat
- Several kinds of modules
- Sandbox mode
- Stylish minimalistic graphics
- Futuristic sound
- Smooth ambient music
- Provides a great challenging experience for players.
- No IAP
- No ADS
